## Test build: faster video downloads (V-codex)

A pre-release for testing. NDM's update check doesn't offer it: download and install it by hand.

- **Video and audio download at the same time**, and the HLS / DASH pieces yt-dlp fetches come in over several connections at once (the download's connection count, up to 64), instead of one piece after another.
- **One stream turned away by NDM's engine goes to yt-dlp alone**; the other keeps downloading.
- **The speed limit covers both streams together**, split between them while both run.
- **Any website yt-dlp supports**: the page's right-click menu "Download this video with New Download Manager" is on every site, and a web page added to a queue or from the command line is handed to yt-dlp. Audio-only pages and playlist pages (their first video) work too.
- **If video and audio can't be joined**, NDM says so and keeps both files, instead of a video without sound.
- **Stop ends yt-dlp and everything it started** at once.
- **Downloads from the browser keep NDM's main window in the notification area**: only the download's own windows show.
